data.name: RunList_Intro

data.value: Your role does not allow starting or stopping test runs.

data.name: Projects_Intro
data.value: A project is one application you test. Its environments, tests and runs belong to it.

data.name: Projects_Empty_Text
data.value: Add one below to start testing an application.

data.name: Projects_Key_Hint
data.value: 2 to 10 letters and digits, starting with a letter, such as SHOP. It appears in addresses and cannot be changed.

data.name: Projects_LoadFailed
data.value: The projects could not be loaded.

data.name: Projects_Error_NotAllowed
data.value: Only an owner or an admin can add projects.

data.name: Projects_Error_NameRequired
data.value: Give the project a name of up to 200 characters.

data.name: Projects_Error_InvalidKey
data.value: The key must be 2 to 10 letters and digits, starting with a letter.

data.name: Projects_Error_KeyTaken
data.value: Another project already uses that key.

data.name: Projects_Error_PlanLimit
data.value: Your plan does not allow another project.

data.name: Environments_Intro
data.value: An environment is one address of the application, such as its staging site. Tests run against an environment only once you have proved the site is yours.

data.name: Environments_NoSuchProject_Text
data.value: There is no project with that key in this organization.

data.name: Environments_Empty_Text
data.value: Add the address of the site you want to test.

data.name: Environments_Proof_Instructions
data.value: To prove the site is yours, publish a file at this address holding exactly this text, then choose Check now.

data.name: Environments_Origin_Hint
data.value: The site's address, such as https://staging.example.com, with nothing after it.

data.name: Environments_LoadFailed
data.value: The environments could not be loaded.

data.name: Environments_Error_NotAllowed
data.value: Only an owner or an admin can change environments.

data.name: Environments_Error_NameRequired
data.value: Give the environment a name of up to 100 characters.

data.name: Environments_Error_InvalidOrigin
data.value: That is not a website address this can test: use https://, a host and nothing after it.

data.name: Environments_Error_NameTaken
data.value: This project already has an environment with that name.

data.name: Environments_Error_OriginTaken
data.value: This project already has an environment at that address.

data.name: Environments_IsProduction_Hint
data.value: The live site real customers use. Tests are refused against it until an owner authorizes them.

data.name: Environments_Production_Refused
data.value: Tests are refused against this production site until an owner authorizes them. Tests can change real data here: orders, bookings, accounts.

data.name: Environments_Production_Acknowledge
data.value: I understand that tests can create, change or delete real data on this site.

data.name: Environments_Production_Authorized

data.name: Environments_Error_InvalidKind
data.value: Choose whether this is a test site or a production site.

data.name: Environments_Error_OwnerOnly
data.value: Only an owner can authorize or withdraw production testing.

data.name: Environments_Error_AcknowledgementRequired
data.value: Tick the acknowledgement first: tests can change real data on a production site.

data.name: Environments_Error_NotProduction
data.value: This is a test site; it needs no authorization.

data.name: Tests_Intro
data.value: Describe a test in a sentence. Autestiq explores the site and the AI writes a plan, which you review before anything runs.

data.name: Tests_Ai_Off
data.value: AI planning is off for this project. Nothing from it is sent to an AI provider until someone who manages projects allows it.

data.name: Tests_Ai_Allowed
data.value: AI planning was allowed for this project on {0}.

data.name: Tests_Ai_Acknowledge

data.name: Tests_Ai_AskAnAdmin
data.value: Ask an owner or an admin to allow it.

data.name: Tests_New_Description_Hint
data.value: One or two sentences, as a tester would say it. For example: Add two cups to the basket and check it says £22.50.

data.name: Tests_New_ReadOnlyNote

data.name: Tests_Empty_Text

data.name: Tests_Error_AiNotAllowed
data.value: AI planning is not allowed for this project.

data.name: AiNotice_Never
data.value: passwords and other secrets, screenshots, recordings or network traces.

data.value: The AI is writing the plan. The page updates by itself.

data.value: Written by the AI and checked by Autestiq's validator. It runs only once an owner or a QA lead approves it, below.

data.value: This plan covers only part of what you asked for. The AI's notes say which part is missing.

data.value: The AI's reasoning, assumptions and what it noticed while exploring. Treat them as things to check, not as facts or requirements.

data.value: Steps {0} may change data on the site: they press a button, press a key or choose an option, or act on something exploring did not see as a link. Autestiq's software decides this from the plan, not the AI.

data.value: This plan signs in with a value the environment's test account does not have, so it cannot be approved. Add it on the Environments page.

data.name: Approval_AskAnApprover
data.value: Ask an owner or a QA lead to approve it.

data.value: Only an owner or a QA lead can approve a plan.

data.value: This test has no plan to approve.

data.name: Tests_Error_NeedsSecret
data.value: This plan signs in with a value the environment's test account does not have. Add it on the Environments page.

data.name: Tests_Error_ChangeAcknowledgementRequired

data.name: Tests_Error_CannotRun

data.name: Approval_Changes_One
data.value: Step {0} may change data on the site: it presses a button, presses a key or chooses an option, or acts on something exploring did not see as a link. Autestiq's software decides this from the plan, not the AI.

data.value: Autestiq runs this test read-only in its own browser. The downloaded file cannot do that: run it only where a test that changes data would be acceptable. Its first lines say so too.

data.name: Settings_Evidence_Intro
data.value: Each step of a run keeps a screenshot as evidence. A screenshot can show whatever your site showed, personal data included, so you choose how long it is kept. Run results and steps are always kept.

data.name: Settings_Evidence_Hint
data.value: A shorter time also applies to screenshots already kept: they are deleted within the hour.

data.name: Settings_AskAnAdmin
data.value: Only an owner, an admin or a QA lead can change this.

data.name: Projects_Error_InvalidRetention
data.value: Choose one of the times offered.

data.name: Run_Steps_ScreenshotDeleted
data.value: The screenshot was deleted under the project's evidence policy, or was never kept.

data.value: Exploring this site only follows links: it presses no button and sends no form. That keeps your data unchanged, but tests of anything that happens after a button press are weaker.

data.name: Environments_Acting_Acknowledge
data.value: I allow exploring this site to press its buttons and send its forms with test values. It can create records, such as test bookings or orders, that I may need to remove. Buttons named for paying, ordering, deleting, cancelling or signing out are never pressed.

data.name: Environments_Acting_Allowed
data.value: Since {0}, exploring this site may press its buttons and send its forms with test values.

data.value: Tick the acknowledgement first: exploring that acts can create records on your site.

data.name: Environments_Error_ActingOnProduction
data.value: Exploring never acts on a production site.

data.value: Exploring pressed these controls and sent these forms with test values. Anything they created is still on your site.

data.value: So that tests can sign in. Use an account made for testing, never a real person's. Values are encrypted and never shown again; type one to replace it.

data.value: No test account: tests of pages behind a sign-in cannot be approved for this environment.

data.value: Type a value of at most 500 characters.
